summary: Backend regression + polish-fix verification for MyFinance. 30/30 pytest tests passed: 18 regression (auth/expenses/debts/budget/buckets/multi-tenancy/401) plus 12 NEW covering DELETE 404 (non-existent + cross-user for expenses/debts/buckets), DELETE owned -> 200 {ok:true}, payment amount<=0 -> 400 'Payment amount must be greater than zero', payment on paid debt -> 400 'Debt already paid off', partial->full payment flow with /debts/paid lifecycle, root health, and lifespan-managed unique email index (duplicate register -> 400).

minor.issue: Still returns the request body rather than the persisted document. Cosmetic only — GET reflects truth.
Overpayment is silently clamped via max(0, remaining-amount). Not a bug per spec, but no warning surface to the client.
Path-id mismatch (debt belongs to another user) returns 404 'Debt not found' which is correct; just noting the same wording is shared with the new amount<=0 / paid checks for clarity.

critical_code_review_comments: lifespan context manager correctly wired via app.router.lifespan_context = lifespan — clean replacement for deprecated on_event.
DELETE endpoints now uniformly check deleted_count and 404 with consistent detail messages ('Expense/Debt/Bucket not found') — good and idempotent-safe.

log_payment ordering: amount validation runs BEFORE the debt lookup. Acceptable because Pydantic-validated body is already coerced; it does mean an invalid amount on a non-existent debt id returns 400 rather than 404 — minor semantic preference, not a bug.
server.py is 301 lines, single-file is fine (well under 700).
MongoDB _id excluded everywhere via projections — confirmed.
All env vars accessed via os.environ['...'] — fail-fast preserved.
No brute-force lockout / rate limiting on /auth/login — flag if security-hardening becomes a requirement (not in this iteration's scope).
Bearer-only auth, no httpOnly cookies — by design per /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
test_credentials: Per-run fresh users via testuser+<ts>@example.com / password123. Shared demo account demo.user@myfinance.test / password123 documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Each run registers 2 fresh module-scoped users (A, B). Auto-seed (4 default buckets + budget) verified. Tests create+delete scoped resources; no production data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Idempotent pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_myfinance_api.py covers auth, CRUD, multi-tenancy, DELETE 404 polish, payment validation, and lifespan index enforcement. Re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_myfinance_api.py -v. All 30 currently green. Frontend was not tested (backend-only request).
